creative_intent: A clean modern power glyph appears with controlled draw-on energy, settles into a centered hero state, powers down through a physical collapse, and resolves to a fully blank black screen.
visual_language: Minimal chroma-key utility motion: pure green field, crisp white-to-soft-gray power glyph, rounded monoline geometry, restrained pulses, and a decisive black shutdown payoff.
continuity_carrier: The same power glyph ring and stem persist through every visible beat, then collapse and hand their visual energy directly into the final full-frame blackout.

styleframes.hero: Partially drawn power ring with descending stem
styleframes.composition: Large centered glyph on uninterrupted chroma green with disciplined negative space
styleframes.quality_note: Stroke silhouette is crisp, keyable, and immediately readable at thumbnail size

styleframes.composition: Centered hero with a subtle authored push-in rather than a static hold
styleframes.quality_note: No text, no decorative clutter, and no shadow contamination on the green field

styleframes.hero: Power glyph compressed during the shutdown press
styleframes.composition: Tighter framing and pulse ring create a distinct impact state while preserving center authority
styleframes.quality_note: The icon remains legible during the fastest change and retains clean chroma separation

styleframes.hero: Ring retracting while the stem lifts away
styleframes.composition: Hero scale and framing pull back as the persistent glyph physically dismantles
styleframes.quality_note: The transition is caused by the same glyph rather than by a screen swap

styleframes.composition: Completely blank black frame with no residual icon, green edge, or visible element
styleframes.quality_note: The final frame is intentionally featureless black and holds cleanly through the end

proof_of_motion.scope: Full draw-on, active settle, press impact, ring retraction, stem lift, scale pull-back, and blackout landing
proof_of_motion.playback_note: The complete ten-second timeline was authored as one deterministic GSAP sequence with readable impact timing and a dedicated black hold at the end

scenes.purpose: Build the power symbol and establish a clean active state
scenes.hero: Persistent white power ring and vertical stem
scenes.depth_plan: Single flat chroma field with scale-based framing changes and pulse geometry kept on the same visual plane
scenes.type_role: No typography is used; the power glyph alone carries the semantic message and motion hierarchy

transition_to_next.cause: The settled power glyph receives a deliberate press impulse
transition_to_next.action: The stem depresses, the hero compresses, and the framing pushes in with a short pulse
transition_to_next.result: The active symbol enters a visibly committed shutdown state
transition_to_next.continuity: The same ring, stem, center point, and motion direction survive into the shutdown beat

scenes.purpose: Turn the active power glyph off through a physical dismantling motion
scenes.hero: The same power glyph changing from complete to retracted
scenes.depth_plan: The stage reframes through controlled scale and vertical shift while the glyph stays visually dominant
scenes.type_role: No typography is used; ring retraction and stem lift provide the semantic handoff

transition_to_next.cause: The glyph has completed its shutdown collapse
transition_to_next.action: The icon disappears and a full-frame black layer replaces the chroma field
transition_to_next.result: The composition resolves into a blank powered-off screen
transition_to_next.continuity: The blackout is the direct payoff of the same shutdown action, not an unrelated new scene

scenes.depth_plan: No depth elements remain; the frame is intentionally uniform and blank
scenes.type_role: No typography or icon remains during the final black hold

review.summary: The piece is intentionally minimal but uses authored framing changes, differentiated motion signatures, a persistent hero carrier, and a resolved blackout ending while preserving a clean chroma-key field before shutdown.
rejected_shortcuts: Static icon with a single fade in and fade out
Decorative text, cards, or extra objects that would weaken chroma-key utility
